expectedResults: Each supported value retains its entered identity; invalid values are deterministically rejected; calculation error is at most ±0.1 cent.
notes: SP-002 domain scope only. User-entry UI and rendered-audio analysis remain downstream.
objective: Verify the platform-neutral pitch domain accepts, preserves, and resolves direct-frequency values without a note identity while retaining calculation precision.
steps: Resolve representative and boundary direct-frequency values at 0.1 Hz resolution without a named pitch.
Reject non-finite, out-of-range, and finer-than-0.1-Hz values deterministically.
Compare resulting frequencies with independently derived vectors and calculate cent error.
title: Direct-frequency and calculation precision
